{{Quote|Wullffwarro. I know that name. He was one of the Republic's greatest soldiers during the Clone Wars.|Garazeb Orrelios|<ref name="TRB">''[[The Rebellion Begins]]''</ref>}}
'''Wullffwarro''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[silverback]] [[Wookiee]] [[Chief]] who fought in the [[Clone Wars]] and was later taken as a [[Slavery|slave]] by the [[Galactic Empire]]. He owned an [[Wullffwarro's Auzituck anti-slaver gunship|''Auzituck'' anti-slaver gunship]].

==Biography==
[[File:Wullffwarro-SWZ.png|thumb|left|270px|Wullffwarro's ''Auzituck'' anti-slaver gunship]]
Wullffwarro was a [[Wookiee]] [[Chief]]<ref name="SWZ">{{FFGXW2|set=Rebel Alliance Conversion Kit|cardname=Wullffwarro}}</ref> from the [[planet]] [[Kashyyyk]]. Prior to the [[Proclamation of the New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], Wullffwarro served alongside the [[Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars]], and also fought in the [[Battle of Kashyyyk]]. Fourteen years after the Empire came to power, Wullffwarro and his son, [[Kitwarr]], were taken from their homeworld to be forced laborers in the [[spice mines of Kessel]]. Not long after being delivered to [[Kessel]], he, Kitwarr, and a group of Wookiees were [[Mission to free Wookiee prisoners|rescued]] by the [[Spectres|rebel crew]] of the ''[[Ghost]]''. In gratitude, Wullffwarro offered to help the Rebels in any way he could.<ref name="VG" /> He later flew an [[Auzituck anti-slaver gunship|''Auzituck'' anti-slaver gunship]].<ref name="SWZ" />
